title: Aggress
summary: AGGRESS', verb intransitive [Latin aggredior, aggressus, of ad and gradior, to go. See Grade.] To make a first attack; to commit the first act of hostility or offense; to begin a quarrel or controvers

inlines.v: AGGRESS', verb intransitive [Latin aggredior, aggressus, of ad and gradior, to go. See Grade.] To make a first attack; to commit the first act of hostility or offense; to begin a quarrel or controversy; to assault first or invade.
